name: La Ciudad (Old Town)
tagline: Historic Moorish quarter atop the gorge
description: The walled Moorish old town south of the Puente Nuevo, with cobbled lanes, whitewashed houses, palaces and the Arab baths. Quiet and atmospheric, packed with monuments but limited nightlife, and busy with day-trippers around the main sights.
bestFor: History lovers and photographers wanting monuments and gorge views at their doorstep

name: Mercadillo (Centro)
tagline: Lively commercial heart north of bridge
description: The main modern centre north of the Puente Nuevo, home to Plaza de Espana, the bullring, shops, banks and most restaurants. This is where daily life happens, with the widest choice of cafes, supermarkets and services in a walkable grid.
bestFor: Nomads wanting cafes, services and restaurants all within walking distance
pros: Close to bus and train links

name: Barrio San Francisco
tagline: Traditional neighbourhood below the old town
description: A traditional residential quarter just south of La Ciudad, outside the old city gate. More local and relaxed, with tapas bars, small squares and the old Arab entrance. Prices are lower and it feels lived-in rather than touristy.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting an authentic residential feel and cheaper tapas
